pipelines.name: material-generation
pipelines.label: Material generation
pipelines.description: Mode A — turn syllabus topics into flashcards and quizzes. One batched LLM call per topic, cached to the local database. Everything pauses at the review gate before it is saved.

steps.label: Load syllabus topics
steps.description: Resolve the topic codes selected in the Generate panel against the active syllabus. Topics always come from the syllabus, never free-typed.

steps.label: Attach overlay connections
steps.description: Look up cross-subject themes for each topic so generated cards carry the overlapping concepts from the other two subjects.

steps.label: Generate flashcards
steps.description: One batched call per topic producing question/answer pairs in the canonical flashcard shape.
steps.systemPromptTemplate: You are generating A-level study material. Stay strictly within the named syllabus topic. Prefer retrieval-practice questions over recognition prompts. Return JSON only.

steps.label: Generate quiz items
steps.description: Derive mixed-topic quiz items from the flashcards produced in the previous step. Algorithmic where possible so no extra tokens are spent.

steps.label: Review before save
steps.description: Block until the user accepts, edits or rejects the generated material. Nothing reaches the database before this step clears.

steps.label: Save to database
steps.description: Persist accepted cards, attaching them to their syllabus topic and recording the generation job for the Dev panel.

pipelines.name: socratic
pipelines.label: Socratic dialogue
pipelines.description: Mode B — multi-turn fire-tending. The system prompt is grounded in the current topic code so questioning stays in scope.

steps.label: Ground in topic
steps.description: Load the current topic code, title and section to scope the conversation.

steps.label: Respond with a question
steps.description: Answer only far enough to ask a better question. Never hand over a completed answer if the student is close.
steps.systemPromptTemplate: You are a Socratic fire-tender for A-level study. Ask, do not tell. Surface the student's reasoning, find the gap, and ask the next question that closes it. Keep replies under 120 words.

pipelines.name: weekly-review
pipelines.label: Weekly valence review
pipelines.description: Summarise the week: coverage delta, valence shifts and the topics that need attention next week.

steps.label: Build the digest
steps.description: Compute coverage delta, retention and valence trends for the last seven days.

steps.label: Email the digest
steps.description: Send the weekly digest to the configured address. Held at the review gate unless NOTIFY_AUTOSEND is true.
steps.systemPromptTemplate: Write a short, plain-text weekly study digest. Lead with what improved, then what needs attention. No filler.
